subject: Onboarding assembly plan: milestones, owners & kick-off week
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Timothy Burns <tburns@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding assembly plan & milestone owners for Nebula Health

Hi Timothy —

Great to meet you yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, and tentative dates so we can get to a committed kick-off. Key asks in this draft:

- Confirm your internal owners for integration, security, and product validation.
- Confirm a preferred kick-off week (we proposed week of Dec 20).
- Flag any procurement/contract constraints that would affect milestone dates.

High-level milestones included in v1: discovery call, SSO & networking, test load run, pilot go/no-go, and production cutover. I’ve also sketched an RACI row for each milestone — please don’t treat it as final, we’ll shift owners where appropriate.

Attachments: Nebula_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx

Next step: if you can reply with names and preferred kick-off date, I’ll publish a v2 and loop in CS for the handoff.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Timothy Burns <tburns@nebulahealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding assembly plan & milestone owners for Nebula Health

Karthik — thanks for the draft. Quick notes from our side:

- Internal owners:
  • Integration: Maya Patel (maya.patel@nebulahealth.com)
  • Security & Compliance: Jordan Ellis (j.ellis@nebulahealth.com)
  • Product Validation / Pilot Lead: Tim O’Rourke (t.orourke@nebulahealth.com)
  • Procurement: procurement@nebulahealth.com

- Preferred kick-off: week of Jan 4 (we have year-end freezes the week of Dec 20).
- Procurement note: we need a final SOW + pricing spreadsheet before we can get PO issued; likely a 2-week review once we have docs.
- Security ask: can you provide SOC2 attestation and a short network diagram for our infra team?

If you can shift the MAP start to Jan 4 and include a realistic procurement lead time, that’ll help. Happy to jump on a 30m call next week to finalize owners if that’s helpful.

—Tim
Timothy Burns
Director, Platform Integrations
Nebula Health

Subject: Re: Onboarding assembly plan & milestone owners for Nebula Health

Timothy — thanks for the quick reply and the owner list. I’m the CS lead who will pick up after sign (hi all). A few items from CS perspective and proposed changes to the MAP:

- Kick-off week: Jan 4 works well for our delivery rhythm. I propose the following cadence: weekly 30m status calls for the first 6 weeks, then biweekly through pilot.
- Milestone adjustments: move discovery completion to Jan 8, SSO & network run Jan 15–22 (network approval must be in place by Jan 12), pilot load test Jan 29, pilot review Feb 5, production cutover target Feb 19.
- Owners (proposed):
  • Discovery / Requirements: karthik_iyer (AE) + Maya Patel (Nebula)
  • SSO / Network: ben_carter (Solutions Eng) + Jordan Ellis (Nebula)
  • Pilot & Validation: marissa_cole (CS Manager) + Tim O’Rourke (Nebula)
  • Production Cutover: marissa_cole + Nebula Ops lead (TBD)
- Procurement contingency: add a 10-business-day procurement review window after we hand over final SOW.

I’ve attached a condensed RACI PDF and will publish a revised workbook (v2) by EOD Wednesday with updated dates and owners. Also attaching SOC2 summary and the high-level network diagram we typically share for dedicated deployments.

Attachments: Nebula_Onboarding_RACI.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf; Blueprint_Network_Diagram.pdf

Please confirm the proposed dates and cadence or flag any conflicts. If you prefer, we can run a 30m sync Thursday to lock this down.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0129

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Onboarding assembly plan & milestone owners for Nebula Health

All —

Thanks Irene — looks great. I’ve updated the workbook per the new dates and added the procurement window. New version attached (Nebula_MAP_v2.xlsx). Key changes:

- Start: Jan 4 discovery kick-off
- Network approval deadline Jan 12
- Pilot test Jan 29, review Feb 5
- Production cutover target Feb 19 with contingency week Feb 26

I’ll also add a single-sheet owner contact list and a short call agenda for the Jan 4 kick-off. Can someone from Nebula confirm the Ops lead (TBD) by Dec 22 so we can populate the RACI?

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hello —

Procurement here. We received the SOW draft and the pricing worksheet from Karthik yesterday. Timeline note: once we have the final SOW and pricing, our internal review is typically 7–10 business days. Please send the finalized docs to procurement@nebulahealth.com and include a single contact for questions (name & phone).

Also to confirm: we will need the SOC2 attestation and any additional security evidence before we can sign; please send to security-evidence@nebulahealth.com.
